title: MLOps — Promote Through a Model Registry
key_insight: A model registry stores versions, metadata, metrics, and lifecycle state such as candidate, approved, or retired. Promotion applies explicit gates.
body:
## Promote Through a Model Registry

A training job creates a promising model, but copying its file directly into production skips evidence and ownership.

A model registry stores versions, metadata, metrics, and lifecycle state such as candidate, approved, or retired. Promotion applies explicit gates.

Package preprocessing with the model or version it as a required dependency. Training-serving mismatch can invalidate an otherwise good artifact.
common_mistakes: MLOps means copying the newest model file into production.
Scheduled retraining makes data validation unnecessary.
A model name alone proves which data produced it.
mini_exercise: Draw “Promote Through a Model Registry” as three labeled steps, then explain the decision at each step.
real_world_usage: Models and their data change, so production quality depends on lifecycle controls beyond ordinary code deployment.
explain_back_prompt: Using “Promote Through a Model Registry,” explain MLOps without assuming the listener knows AI engineering.
